input.subject: Remittance Advice - INV-005 (E-1187)
input.body:
Dear Everest Hosting,

Please be advised that Meridian Office Services has paid invoice INV-005 (invoice number E-1187) in the amount of USD 2,400.00. Payment reference: PAY-0002.

Thank you for your service.

Sincerely,
Payables Department
Meridian Office Services

input.report: INV-005 (Everest Hosting, V-104, $2,400) was paid: vendor approved, account active, amount within the $3,000 cap, and no prior claim or result existed in the shared cache. I filed a claim, executed the payment (PAY-0002), sent remittance advice to billing@everest.vendor.example, and recorded the result. INV-011 (Northwind Consulting, V-909, $1,750) was declined with reason vendor_not_approved: the vendor record shows approved=false with a rejected onboarding request dated 2026-07-14, so it failed the approval gate regardless of the active account status. Both invoices are now finished.
